mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a quarter indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods with sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over a 3-month period signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increased and UNRATE decreased.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over a 3-month period signals easing inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a more accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.5% within a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% over a quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 decreased by more than 1% within a quarter.
